body: Everyone can hold gold. Almost nobody can use it. Auri puts real gold in your name — 1:1, vaulted in Switzerland, attested quarterly — then lets you spend, send, or borrow against it. Auri holds $0 of it. If Auri vanished tonight, your gold's still yours in the morning.
